name: Diatoms (Brown Algae)
description: Brown dusty film coating surfaces in new tanks — silicate-fed diatoms that bloom in low light and fade as the tank matures. Suppressed by strong flow. growthRate / lightDependence are MODELLED tuning weights, not measured rates.
notes: Otocinclus and nerite snails graze the soft film readily — the classic new-tank cleanup crew. Usually self-resolves within weeks as silicate depletes.
